title: Write Vitest unit tests for the AI pipeline stages
description: Write Vitest unit tests for the AI pipeline stages. Mock all AI SDK calls using vi.mock. Test each stage function in isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: Test files exist for: extractionStage, condensationStage, structureDecision, contentGeneration, variantAssignment, colorTheming
All AI SDK calls are mocked with vi.mock('@ai-sdk/anthropic') and vi.mock('ai')
Each test verifies the output structure matches the Zod schema
No real API calls made during tests

steps.description: Create src/lib/pipeline/__tests__/ directory with test files
steps.details: Create test files: variantAssignment.test.ts (no mocks needed, pure function), colorTheming.test.ts (no mocks), structureDecision.test.ts (mock generateObject).
Test: same businessName+industry always returns same variant index. Different inputs return different variants. Variant index is within bounds for the section type's variant count.

steps.description: Write structureDecision tests with mocked AI
steps.details: Mock `generateObject` to return a valid StructureDecisionSchema output. Test that structureDecision correctly passes business data to the AI and returns the section list.
Mock `generateObject` to return valid ContentSchema output. Test that contentGeneration calls AI with correct prompts and returns content for each section.
Run `npm test`. All tests pass. No actual API calls are made (no API key needed).
